tickets.title: Prepare manual in-kind transfer package
tickets.text: Prepare a manual in-kind transfer package for Lena Copperwisp’s joint taxable account at Silver Marmot Brokerage to be moved to Velvet Acorn Custody, preserving the in‑kind transfer instruction for the taxable holdings.
tickets.evidence: They agreed that a manual package preserving the in-kind transfer instruction for the taxable holdings would be prepared, due 2024-08-02.

tickets.title: Resolve repeated upload loop for identity verification
tickets.text: Resolve the repeated upload loop preventing identity verification for Lena Copperwisp with Velvet Acorn Custody, ensuring the registration can be cleared without resubmitting documents.
tickets.evidence: Lena asked Apricot Compass Advisory to help resolve the repeated upload loop rather than asking her to resubmit the same identification through the portal again; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-07-31.

tickets.title: Coordinate cost basis import for low‑basis shares
tickets.text: Coordinate with Velvet Acorn Custody to confirm cost basis import settings for Lena Copperwisp’s low‑basis Pocket Lantern Robotics shares in the transferred taxable holdings.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to coordinate with Velvet Acorn Custody so the transferred lots are not booked as unidentified positions, due 2024-08-06.

tickets.title: Obtain trust certification for taxable account
tickets.text: Obtain and submit an acceptable trust certification or trustee authority document for Lena Copperwisp’s taxable account registration under the Copper Firefly Revocable Trust with Velvet Acorn Custody.
tickets.evidence: the receiving custodian still needs an acceptable trust certification or equivalent trustee authority document before the registration can be finalized; this remains needed, with a 2024-08-05 date.

tickets.title: Initiate rollover IRA setup with Velvet Acorn
tickets.text: Initiate the rollover IRA setup for Lena Copperwisp with Velvet Acorn Custody and coordinate direct‑rollover instructions once plan access is confirmed.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to start the Velvet Acorn Custody rollover IRA setup and coordinate direct-rollover instructions after plan access is confirmed, due 2024-08-09.

tickets.title: Reconcile owner-name mismatch on inherited IRA
tickets.text: Reconcile the owner‑name mismatch on Colin Copperwisp’s inherited IRA before resubmitting the transfer request to Velvet Acorn Custody.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to reconcile the titling before submitting another transfer request so the inherited IRA registration is not rejected, due 2024-08-07.

tickets.title: Obtain recent statement for inherited IRA
tickets.text: Obtain the most recent statement for Colin Copperwisp’s inherited IRA to provide to Velvet Acorn Custody for registration review.
tickets.evidence: the receiving custodian requested a current statement showing the inherited IRA registration, but Colin’s online access at Silver Marmot Brokerage did not display the needed document during the call; obtaining the statement remains needed, with a 2024-08-04 date.

tickets.title: Track transfer sequence to meet timing target
tickets.text: Track the transfer sequence of the Copperwisp household accounts to ensure completion before the Silver Marmot Brokerage fee increase, meeting the client‑imposed timing target.
tickets.evidence: For transfer timing before the Silver Marmot Brokerage fee change, Lena said she wants the main household accounts moved before the prior custodian’s announced household service fee increase, and they agreed to track the transfer sequence against that client-imposed timing target, due 2024-08-23.
